claims.claim: Rosa demoed the policy pricing model on Mosaic's policy extract, the claims dashboard, and the governance setup.
claims.why: Demo content matches Victor's agenda and Rosa's segments.

claims.claim: Neil said he has mostly made up his mind and wants to sign by end of month.
claims.why: Direct quote of Neil's statement.

claims.claim: Prompted by Amira, Neil said the deal likely needs board technology committee approval because it is over the $300K threshold.
claims.why: Amira raised it, Neil agreed 'yes, technically'. 'Likely' is fair; threshold was last year's.

claims.claim: The board meets in November.
claims.why: Neil said they meet in November.

claims.claim: Neil's timeline is end of month only if he gets an exception, otherwise after the November meeting.
claims.why: Matches Neil's conditional statement.

claims.claim: The pricing model has versioned rating factors so you can see which factors were used for any quote.
claims.why: Rosa said this verbatim in substance.

claims.claim: The new model can run side by side with the current one for any date range, which Amira's actuaries want.
claims.why: Amira said actuaries will want to compare; Rosa confirmed side-by-side runs.

claims.claim: The claims dashboard shows daily loss ratio by line and region.
claims.why: Rosa said loss ratio by line and region, refreshed daily.

claims.claim: Daily loss ratio matches the stated business outcome of changing how they reprice.
claims.why: Amira said daily would change how they reprice; CRM outcome matches.

claims.claim: Only the pricing committee role can change rating factors, and every change is logged.
claims.why: Rosa stated this directly.

claims.claim: Neil said governance is what the regulator asks about.
claims.why: Neil said 'That's what the regulator asks about.'

claims.claim: Mid-term endorsement handling was not shown, and Amira needs to see it.
claims.why: Amira said it wasn't in the demo; Rosa agreed.

claims.claim: Neil wants paper (the order form) quickly.
claims.why: Neil asked for the order form twice.

claims.claim: Neil is unsure whether he can get board approval before November.
claims.why: Neil said he is not certain.

claims.claim: Amira's actuaries will compare the model against the current one.
claims.why: Amira said actuaries will want to compare.

claims.claim: Amira wants daily loss ratio since the current report is monthly.
claims.why: Amira said today it is monthly and daily would change repricing.

claims.claim: Neil's sign by end of month is conditional on an exception he is not certain he can get.

claims.claim: The CRM close date of Dec 18 looks closer to the realistic path.

claims.why: CRM shows champion and economic_buyer both Neil Patterson.

claims.claim: The roughly $410K ACV exceeds the $300K threshold Amira cited.

claims.claim: The board technology committee appears to be the real approval gate.

claims.claim: Neil said 'probably' and 'I think' about the exception.

claims.claim: Mid-term endorsements were not demoed.
claims.why: Amira and Rosa confirmed it wasn't in the demo.

claims.claim: Sending the order form before approval is mapped can create false momentum and invite discount or terms pressure.
claims.why: Speculative judgment not stated in the call; no discount or terms pressure was discussed.

claims.claim: No competitors are recorded and the call did not test for any.
claims.why: CRM competitors is empty and none were mentioned in the transcript.

claims.claim: The exception criteria and the November meeting date are unknown.
